text: As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about the ethical questions it raises. One major problem is bias. If AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medical care. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI often collects and uses personal information. People need to know how their data is used and protected. Finally, transparency matters. We should understand how AI systems make decisions. Only through responsible AI development can we build technology that helps everyone and respects human values.
